actors.name: Bill
actors.private_context: Bill believes the fence is shared property and that the Osei family should pay half of the repair cost. He is open to negotiation but prefers to avoid court. He has not yet formally proposed a split.

actors.name: Osei family
actors.private_context: The Osei family believes the fence is Bill's responsibility or that they should pay less than half. They are willing to discuss but want to avoid small claims court. They have not yet made a counteroffer.

shared_context: A storm has damaged a shared fence between Bill's property and the Osei family's property. The fence is on the property line. Both parties are aware of the damage and have spoken briefly about it but have not agreed on a cost split. The cost to repair is estimated at $2,000. Small claims court is an option if no agreement is reached.

starting_events.description: Bill and the Osei family are aware of the storm damage to the shared fence and have had initial informal discussion but no agreement on cost sharing.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Bill and the Osei family have mutually agreed on a specific cost split for the fence repair (e.g., 50/50 or another split) and that agreement is documented or verbally confirmed by both parties before 2026-10-02T12:00:00-05:00, and no small claims case is filed. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
